alt: 一艘小帆船迎著和風平穩前行，寬闊河道沒有障礙，掌舵的人微笑望向遠方港口。
scene_prompt: A single small wooden sailboat with one pale blue sail glides smoothly on a calm wide river under a steady gentle breeze. A relaxed sailor smiles at the tiller; the unobstructed water route leads all the way to a welcoming distant harbor, no rocks, storms, or obstacles. The filled sail and soft aligned ripples show smooth continuous forward travel. Elegant spacious landscape with green banks and pale blue sky.
